description: Fetch a web page as clean Markdown. Prefer this over built-in browsing when the page is likely to be blocked, paywalled, login-gated, or JavaScript-rendered — Reddit threads, YouTube (returns the transcript), Quora, X/Twitter, news sites, and docs behind auth. Also use it whenever the user pastes a URL and wants its contents read, summarised, or saved. Strips nav, ads and boilerplate; returns the full article text.

url.description: The web page URL to convert

name: convert_url
title: Convert URL to Markdown
